zh: 每个元素是否计入只看它自己的标准十进制写法里有几个 0，元素之间互不影响。注意整数 0 本身写作一个 0，正好是奇数个。
把每个数转成标准十进制字符串，数出其中字符 0 的个数，判断奇偶后累加。
读入 n 和 n 个整数；对每个整数取其十进制字符串，统计字符 0 的数量，数量为奇数则答案加 1；最后输出答案。
en: Whether an element counts depends only on how many zeros its own standard decimal form contains, so elements are independent. Note that the integer 0 is written as a single 0, which is an odd count.
Convert each number to its standard decimal string, count the zero characters, and add one to the answer when the count is odd.
Read n and the n integers. For each one, take its decimal string and count the character 0; if the count is odd, add 1 to the answer. Print the answer.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Convert each element to its standard decimal string, count the zeros, and check the parity.

## Correctness

Each character in the standard representation corresponds to one digit, so the elements with an odd count are exactly those that satisfy the definition; add them up element by element.

## Complexity

Time O(n·D) with D≤10; extra space O(D).
